label: Twin scalar collectible companions for the covered-long-term-gain eligible transaction (ADR-0054): proceeds and basis, each its own additive source family sharing the object member's identity

fact_types.title: Scalar proceeds companion (ADR-0054 Decision 2) for one eligible covered-long-term-gain transaction, at the same identity as tax.us.2025.f1099b.covered-ltcg-txn. Written together with the object finding and both scalar companions at contribution time; a correction to the transaction's proceeds corrects this finding at the same identity. Exists purely to make column (d) collectible via the ordinary collect_members mechanism, which requires a scalar member value; the object finding remains the audit record of the full contributed predicate and the sole admission gate.

Scalar basis companion (ADR-0054 Decision 2) for one eligible covered-long-term-gain transaction, at the same identity as tax.us.2025.f1099b.covered-ltcg-txn. Written together with the object finding and both scalar companions at contribution time; a correction to the transaction's basis corrects this finding at the same identity. Exists purely to make column (e) collectible via the ordinary collect_members mechanism, which requires a scalar member value; the object finding remains the audit record of the full contributed predicate and the sole admission gate.
